response.sql:
SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples
FROM batting_postseason
WHERE player_id IN (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM batting_postseason
    WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS'
)
GROUP BY player_id
ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The NL World Series condition determines which players qualify; each qualifying player's total includes triples from all of their postseason batting records, regardless of league or round.
